dedupe_keys.name: wind farm graph flow test data

description: Jens Peter Schøler and colleagues at the Technical University of Denmark publish graph-structured test data generated with PyWake wind-farm simulations. The November 2025 release contains a preprocessed test archive, scaling and summary JSON files, plus pickled graph-plot components. Downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. The provider formats outputs for PyTorch Geometric to support graph-neural-network experiments on wind-farm flow. These graphs can benchmark surrogate models against their originating simulation outputs. They are simulated, not measured field conditions, and the landing page does not specify graph count, turbine configurations, geographic sites or inflow ranges. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this test set. The scaling files indicate preprocessing dependencies that must accompany comparisons. Numerical uncertainty, train/test separation and predictive performance were not independently checked; no files were loaded or executed.
